snippet.title: Woolfall - Gameplay Trailer | Co-op Sheep Mining Sandbox | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Build a mine. Fill it with sheep. Watch the ground do the rest. Wishlist Woolfall on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5541530/Woolfall/

Woolfall is a 2D pixel-art mining sandbox about a shepherd, a pickaxe and a flock of sheep with no idea what they're doing. Dig a route deep underground, lead your flock to the wool portal and shear them for finer and finer wool, while sand slides, water finds the lava, fire follows the roots and gas waits for a spark. Play solo, or online co-op with up to three friends to blame.

🐑 Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players
⛏️ Dig, flood, burn and blow up everything under the grass
🐾 13 pets to find, each with a mind of its own
📅 Coming 2027 to PC (Steam)

What you'll be doing:

Digging through six lands, from the desert's quicksand to the volcano
Building the route: planks, ramps, ladders, bridges over lava, springboards and mine carts
Leading your flock past dye springs, glowing mushroom groves and crystal caves for finer wool
Letting water, lava, fire and gas meet, by accident or on purpose (you do have dynamite)
Welcoming poofed sheep home as small clouds with faces, because sheep never die
Finding hats, pets and stranger things in chests
Dressing a giant sheep in all the wool your flock brings in
Throwing sheep at your friends in online co-op for up to four players

More from VindR Games: https://vindrgames.com

If it made you smile, a wishlist helps a lot:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5541530/Woolfall/

#Woolfall #IndieGame #CoopGames #PixelArt #SoloDev
